北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，但体感稍凉，记得多喝水，注意保湿哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing, but feels cool. Stay hydrated and moisturize!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷有风，体感 3℃，多穿点，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and windy in Cixi, feels like 3℃. Bundle up to stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 6℃ 略冷。出门记得添衣保暖！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is partly cloudy, feels a bit chilly at 6℃. Wear extra layers!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感舒适。注意早晚温差，别忘了带伞哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Guangzhou, feels pleasant. Mind temperature changes, bring an umbrella.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，温暖舒适。享受好天气，记得心情也要美丽！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm. Enjoy the good weather, keep your spirits up!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感只有 4℃。保暖要紧，多喝热水哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cold, feels like 4℃. Stay warm, drink hot water!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 5℃ 左右。注意防寒保暖，谨防感冒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels about 5℃. Stay warm to avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感宜人。保持好心情，来杯热茶也很棒！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and pleasant. Keep smiling, a warm tea would be nice!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷潮湿，体感 5℃。记得多穿衣，注意防潮哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, cold, and damp, feels like 5℃. Dress warm, watch out for dampness.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 7℃，多喝水。享受阳光，别忘了加件外套。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Xi'an, feels 7℃. Drink water, enjoy the sun, and bring a jacket.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 12℃，有些湿润。出门别忘带伞，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chongqing, feels 12℃ and a bit damp. Bring an umbrella, mind the humidity.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴冷，体感 -13℃！全副武装，千万注意防寒防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and extremely cold, feels like -13℃! Bundle up, beware of frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷有风，体感 2℃。记得防风保暖，多添衣物。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, cold, and windy, feels like 2℃. Stay warm, dress in layers.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感舒适。风力 3级，注意防晒和补水哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant in Kunming, feels 16℃ with a 3-level wind. Sun protection and hydration!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴冷多风，体感 10℃。湿度大，注意保暖防风防潮哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, cold, and windy, feels 10℃. High humidity, stay warm and dry.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷潮湿，体感 2℃。多穿点，注意防寒保暖哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, cold, and damp, feels like 2℃. Dress warm, stay cozy!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，但体感 3℃，记得多穿。享受阳光，注意补水！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Dalian, but feels like 3℃, dress warmly. Enjoy the sun, hydrate!
